localChanges: Eleven of the entries in this window were blank, including one for every release: a commit written as a subject with no body had that subject mistaken for a `Co-Authored-By:`-style trailer and thrown away. They have their text back, and an entry with nothing in it is no longer shown at all.
The end-of-turn button now dims and stops responding the moment it is pressed, rather than sitting there inviting a second press that would send the turn twice.
